note: Fifteen measured regions, fifteen accounted: ten figure rows for nine numbered figures plus one uncaptioned chart, and five counted tables for four numbered tables plus the unnumbered symbol glossary. No region is excluded and no printed exhibit is missing from the pass. Two exhibits carry the number Figure 7 - the workflow on p15 and the infection model on p19 - and both are recorded as printed.
rules: The paper prints two different exhibits both numbered Figure 7, the workflow on p15 and the infection model on p19, and each is recorded on its own row rather than renumbered [caption.numbering].

One caption in the paper has no colon after its number - 'Figure 3 Abnormal nodes observed by correlation ...' - so its numbering reads `Figure N` while every other figure caption reads `Figure N:` [caption.numbering].
The symbol glossary on p4 carries no printed number and no caption line at all, so it is counted as a table with an empty caption and `caption_source: none` [table.rows] [caption.verbatim].
Tables 1 and 3 are two side-by-side blocks under one merged title row reading 'Task 1 Statistics' and 'Task 2 Statistics', so each is one table with a merged cell, not two [table.merged_cells].
Table 3's in-grid title says Task 2 while its printed caption says 'in Task 1'; the caption is quoted as printed and the mismatch is stated in the row note [caption.verbatim].

The paired-bar chart beside Table 4 on p12 is printed with no number and no caption and is cited by no sentence, so it is recorded with an empty caption and an empty mention block rather than being folded into the table [mention.count].
Only Figure 1 is cited in running text ('In Figure 1, from the total number of conversations'); the other fourteen rows are read through their captions alone [mention.lead_sentence].

Almost every figure in this paper is a pasted raster, so the axis titles are the only readable scale and several carry tick marks with no tick numbers; those rows take printed_numbers false even where gridlines appear [geometry.printed_numbers].
The paper prints four headings and none carries a number, so every row is routed to the unnumbered Introduction section with section_numbered false [place.section_numbered].

tables.note: An unnumbered glossary: 'Symbol | Definition | Formula' over twenty-four symbols, from G and N down through the message counters ms_n, mr_n, ts_n and tr_n to the harmonic series hs and hr and the closeness heuristic d. The Formula column is filled on only half the rows. A closed box with vertical rules between the three columns, a rule above and under the header and no rules between body rows; nothing prints as a table number, so the record carries an empty caption.
